exposure: pain and fear management after childbirth
outcome: Pelvic floor function (measured by the PFQ)
cohort: Women who delivered in a specific hospital between 2015 and 2016 (n=308)
finding: In primiparous women, there was no association between mode of delivery and pelvic floor function 3-4 years postpartum, but postpartum pain and insufficient pain/fear management during labor were negatively associated with pelvic floor function.
mod_finding: No association was found between mode of delivery and pelvic floor function in primiparous women three to four years after childbirth.
